cache_decision: Retain current per-layer policy. Global byte LRU predicted 2-5% more decode reads on all three traces. Replay is not runtime timing and current eviction differs from pure LRU.

excluded_runs.reason: 920 new system swapouts; successful 2.68 GiB process execution, timing excluded and repeated.
2048 MiB cache run had 40620 system swapouts. Excluded from speed comparison.
Host admission denied; no timing claim.

tokenizer_fix: Recognize exact Qwen combining-mark Split pattern, using pinned Unicode 16 mark ranges. Previous GPT-2 fallback split assistant newline prefixes differently after appending content, preventing chat reuse.

validation.tokenizer_suite: lib-tokenizer-test passed after mark-aware scanner fix
validation.flash_cli_streaming: All 3 stdout captures exactly match reference decoded output IDs plus terminal newline
validation.lint_format_license: Python ruff, Zig fmt, license headers, and git diff --check passed

qwen35.coverage: forced accepted/rejected target draft; replay and full-vocabulary continuation parity, abs <= 0.001

flash.coverage: 8/4/4-token chunks vs sequential steps; every recurrent state, logits, ngram state, and continuation

validation.installed_check_note: Installed-model checks exercised the same final numerical source. The subsequent final build added CLI thinking guards and per-step session pressure checks; focused suites were rerun.
validation.raw_session_checks: Both models passed raw prefix continuation, reset/recompute token equality, mismatched prefix reset, invalid request recovery, and reset-to-initial equality before the tokenizer fix. Final chat checks are separately recorded.

decisions.sessions: Available for both models, thinking disabled. Final chat tests pass; prefix mismatch recomputes safely.
decisions.flash_prefill: Combined batch-linear/MPS prototype is opt-in and off by default; 3-6% slower prefill in these three single-run comparisons.
decisions.qwen27_chunk: Default 512 retained. Optional 1024 reduced 1024-token document prefill by 10.35%, with about 202 MiB additional peak footprint. 4096-token performance not remeasured.
decisions.qwen27_lookup: Off by default. Favorable synthetic repeated-x workload improved end-to-end latency 2.19x and decode 3.43x. General chat acceptance and lookup-enabled sessions are not qualified.
decisions.cache: Retain per-layer policy and use 1536 MiB Flash cache in the terminal client.
